parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the product to be created.
The product name must be 4 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

<notice> The product name must be unique within the current instance.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
为新建产品命名。
产品名称长度为4~30个字符，可以包含中文、英文字母、数字和下划线（_）。一个中文算2个字符。

<notice> 产品名称在当前实例下需保持唯一。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_name

parameters.help_en:
The node type of the product. Valid values:

0: device. A device cannot attach sub-devices. It can connect to IoT Platform directly or as a sub-device of a gateway. When the device serves as a sub-device of a gateway, you must also specify ProtocolType.
1: gateway. A gateway can attach sub-devices. It has a sub-device management module that maintains the topological relationships of sub-devices and synchronizes the topological relationships to IoT Platform.

<props="china">
<notice>Under an MQTT-type instance, the device must connect to IoT Platform as a directly connected device, and NodeType must be set to 0.
</notice></props>
parameters.help_zh:
产品的节点类型，取值：

0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备。可以直连物联网平台，也可以作为网关的子设备连接物联网平台。作为网关子设备时，必须同时传入ProtocolType。
1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备，具有子设备管理模块，维持子设备的拓扑关系，和将拓扑关系同步到物联网平台。

<props="china">
<notice>MQTT型实例下，设备需作为直连设备接入物联网平台，NodeType必须传入0.。
</notice></props>
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en:
The data format. Valid values:

0: pass-through/custom format (CUSTOM_FORMAT).
1: Alink protocol (ALINK_FORMAT).

<props="china">
<notice>Under an MQTT-type instance, the data format for device communication is raw custom format, and DataFormat must be set to 0.
</notice></props>
parameters.help_zh:
数据格式。可选值：

0：透传/自定义格式（CUSTOM_FORMAT）。
1：Alink协议（ALINK_FORMAT）。

<props="china">
<notice>MQTT型实例下，设备通信的数据格式为原始自定义格式，DataFormat必须传入0。
</notice></props>
parameters.name: data_format

parameters.help_en: The description of the product. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 为新建产品添加描述信息。长度不超过100个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the product. 

If you do not specify this parameter, a Basic Edition product is created by default, which does not support the Thing Specification Language model.
If you specify this parameter, only iothub_senior is supported, which indicates that a product that uses the Thing Specification Language model is created. In this case, you must also specify the DataFormat parameter.

<props="china">
<notice>
Under an MQTT-type instance, the Thing Specification Language model is not supported. Do not specify this parameter.
For Basic Edition products, the Online Debug and Event Response features are not supported in the IoT Platform console.

</notice></props>

<props="intl">
<notice>For Basic Edition products, the Online Debug feature is not supported in the IoT Platform console.
</notice></props>
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本类型。 

不传入此参数：表示默认创建基础版产品，不支持使用物模型。
传入此参数：仅支持输入iothub_senior，表示创建使用物模型的产品。此时需要同时传入参数DataFormat。

<props="china">
<notice>
MQTT型实例下，不支持使用物模型，无需传入此参数。
对于基础版产品，不支持在物联网平台控制台使用在线调试和事件响应功能。

</notice></props>

<props="intl">
<notice>对于基础版产品，不支持在物联网平台控制台使用在线调试功能。
</notice></props>
parameters.name: aliyun_commodity_code

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">Specifies whether to enable ID²-based authentication. Valid values:</props>

<props="china">
true: Enable ID²-based authentication.
false: Do not enable ID²-based authentication.

</props>

<props="china">If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is false, which means ID²-based authentication is not enabled.</props>

<props="china">
Only the China (Shanghai) region supports ID²-based authentication. If this parameter is set to true but the AuthType parameter is not set to id2, the system uses the value of the AuthType parameter.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">是否使用ID²认证。可选值：</props>

<props="china">
true：开通ID²认证。
false：不开通ID²认证。

</props>

<props="china">不传入此参数，则默认为false，不开通ID²认证。</props>

<props="china">
仅华东2（上海）地域支持ID²认证方式。如果此参数值设置为true，但传入的AuthType参数值不是id2，系统将以AuthType参数值为准。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入。</props>
parameters.name: id_2

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type used by the device to connect to the gateway.
Specify this parameter if the product uses the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior) and the devices under the product need to connect to IoT Platform through a gateway.

Valid values:

modbus: Modbus protocol.
opc-ua: OPC UA protocol.
customize: custom protocol.
ble: BLE protocol.
zigbee: ZigBee protocol
parameters.help_zh:
设备接入网关的协议类型。
使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior），且产品下的设备需通过网关接入物联网平台，需传入此参数。

可选值：

modbus：Modbus协议。
opc-ua：OPC UA协议。
customize：自定义协议。
ble：BLE协议。
zigbee：ZigBee协议
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en:
The network connection type.
Specify this parameter if the devices under the product are gateway devices or directly connected devices.

Valid values:

<props="china">- LORA: LoRaWAN.</props>
WIFI: Wi-Fi.
CELLULAR: cellular network.
ETHERNET: Ethernet.
OTHER: other.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is Wi-Fi.

<props="china">
<notice>Under an MQTT-type instance, NetType does not support the value LORA.
</notice></props>
parameters.help_zh:
连网方式。
产品下的设备为网关设备或直连设备时，需传入此参数。

可选值：

<props="china">- LORA：LoRaWAN。</props>
WIFI： Wi-Fi。
CELLULAR：蜂窝网。
ETHERNET：以太网。
OTHER：其他。

若不传入此参数，则默认为Wi-Fi。

<props="china">
<notice>MQTT型实例下，NetType不支持传入LORA。
</notice></props>
parameters.name: net_type

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The LoRaWAN network credential ID. This parameter is required if the network connection type NetType is set to LORA.</props>

<props="china">Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109293.html to query the JoinPermissionId of the LoRaWAN network credentials under your account.</props>

<props="china">If you do not have a LoRaWAN network credential, go to the Link WAN console (https://linkwan.console.aliyun.com/join-permission-authorization) to create one.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">LoRaWAN入网凭证ID。连网方式NetType选择为LORA时，该参数必需。</props>

<props="china">请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109293.html查询您账号下的LoRaWAN入网凭证的**JoinPermissionId**。</props>

<props="china">如果您还没有LoRaWAN入网凭证，请访问物联网络管理平台 (https://linkwan.console.aliyun.com/join-permission-authorization)创建。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入。</props>
parameters.name: join_permission_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

<notice>
Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance level. The request parameter ResourceGroupId is no longer effective and does not need to be specified.
Resource groups previously set by calling this API remain effective.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>
目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
历史调用本API设置的资源组仍有效。

</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The authentication method for devices under the product to connect to IoT Platform.

<props="china">
secret: uses the device secret for device identity authentication. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73742.html.

id2: uses IoT Device ID (ID²) for authentication.

    > Only the China (Shanghai) region supports ID²-based authentication. Products with the network connection type NetType set to LORA do not support ID²-based authentication. To use ID²-based authentication, you must purchase the ID² service.

   For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141661.html.

one-party: requires importing device authentication information (UserName, Password, SN) to IoT Platform, which authenticates devices based on the imported information.

    > Only under an MQTT-type instance can AuthType be set to one-party, and it must be set to one-party.


</props>


<props="china">If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is secret.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter. The default value is secret, which indicates that the device secret is used for device identity authentication. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73742.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
产品下的设备接入物联网平台的认证方式。

<props="china">
secret：使用设备密钥进行设备身份认证。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73742.html。

id2：使用物联网设备身份认证ID²。

    > 仅华东2（上海）地域支持ID²认证方式。连网方式NetType为LORA的产品不支持ID²认证方式。 选择使用ID²认证，需购买ID²服务。

   更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141661.html。

one-party：需要将设备认证信息（UserName、Password、SN）导入物联网平台，物联网平台基于设备认证信息对设备进行身份认证。

    > 仅MQTT型实例下，AuthType可以且必须传入one-party。


</props>


<props="china">若不传入此参数，默认值为secret。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入此参数。默认值为secret，表示使用设备密钥进行设备身份认证。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73742.html。</props>
parameters.name: auth_type

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the product category. If you specify this parameter, the created product uses the Thing Specification Language model of the specified category. If you do not specify this parameter, no standard Thing Specification Language model of any category is used.
Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150316.html to view the predefined category information of IoT Platform and obtain the value of CategoryKey from the response
parameters.help_zh:
产品品类的标识符。如果传入此参数，创建的产品将使用指定品类的物模型；不传入，则不使用任何品类的标准物模型。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150316.html，从返回结果中查看物联网平台预定义的品类信息，获取CategoryKey的取值
parameters.name: category_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically publish the Thing Specification Language model after the product is created.

true: Publish.
false: Do not publish.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is true
parameters.help_zh:
是否在产品创建后自动发布物模型。

true：发布。
false：不发布。

不传入此参数，取默认值为true
parameters.name: publish_auto

parameters.help_en:
The data validation level. If you do not specify this parameter, weak validation is used by default. Valid values:

1: weak validation. Only the identifier and dataType fields of device data are validated. Other fields are not validated, and full data is forwarded.

 Data that passes validation is displayed on the TSL Data tab of the Device Details page in the IoT Platform console. Data that fails validation is not displayed.

 You can view data that fails validation through the checkFailedData parameter in forwarded data. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73736.html.

2: no validation. Reported data is not validated, and full data is forwarded.

 Data is not displayed on the TSL Data tab of the Device Details page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh:
数据校验级别。不传入此参数时，默认为弱校验。可取值：

1：弱校验。只校验设备数据的idetifier和dataType字段，不校验其他字段，可流转全量数据。

 校验通过的数据展示在物联网平台控制台对应设备的设备详情页物模型数据页签。校验不通过的数据则不展示。

 通过流转数据中的参数checkFailedData，可查看校验不通过的数据。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73736.html。

2：免校验。对上报的数据不进行校验，流转全量数据。

 数据不展示在物联网平台控制台对应设备的设备详情页物模型数据页签
parameters.name: validate_type

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The information about the created product returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的新建产品信息

AliyunCommodityCode.description_en:
The product type.

iothub_senior: uses the Thing Specification Language model.
iothub: does not use the Thing Specification Language model
AliyunCommodityCode.description_zh:
产品类型。

iothub_senior：使用物模型。
iothub：不使用物模型

AuthType.description_en:
The authentication method for devices under the product to connect to IoT Platform.

<props="china">
secret: uses the device secret for device identity authentication.
id2: uses IoT Device ID (ID²) for authentication.
one-party: uses custom authentication information (Username, Password, SN) for authentication.

</props>
AuthType.description_zh:
产品下的设备接入物联网平台的认证方式。

<props="china">
secret：使用设备密钥进行设备身份认证。
id2：使用物联网设备身份认证ID²。
one-party：使用自定义认证信息（Username、Password、SN）认证。

</props>

DataFormat.description_en:
The data format of the product.

0: pass-through/custom format (CUSTOM_FORMAT).
1: Alink protocol (ALINK_FORMAT).

This parameter is specific to products that use the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior)
DataFormat.description_zh:
产品类型数据格式。

0：透传/自定义格式（CUSTOM_FORMAT）。
1：Alink协议（ALINK_FORMAT）。

此参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）特有参数

Id2.description_en:
Indicates whether ID²-based authentication is enabled.

true: ID²-based authentication is enabled.
false: ID²-based authentication is not enabled
Id2.description_zh:
是否使用ID²认证。

true：开通ID²认证。
false：不开通ID²认证

NodeType.description_en:
The node type of the product. Valid values:

0: device. A device cannot attach sub-devices. It can connect to IoT Platform directly or as a sub-device of a gateway.
1: gateway. A gateway can attach sub-devices. It has a sub-device management module that maintains the topological relationships of sub-devices and synchronizes the topological relationships to IoT Platform.

This parameter is specific to products that use the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior)
NodeType.description_zh:
产品的节点类型，取值：

0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备。可以直连物联网平台，也可以作为网关的子设备连接物联网平台。
1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备，具有子设备管理模块，维持子设备的拓扑关系，和将拓扑关系同步到物联网平台。

此参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）特有参数

ProductKey.description_en:
The globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the created product.

Keep the ProductKey of the created product safe. It is required in other operations
ProductKey.description_zh:
物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识。

请妥善保管新建产品的ProductKey。在其他操作中会用到该信息

ProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type used by the device to connect to the gateway.

This parameter is specific to products that use the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior)
ProtocolType.description_zh:
设备接入网关协议类型。

此参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）特有参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product. This is the globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the product
ProductKey.description_zh: 产品的ProductKey，物联网平台为产品颁发的唯一标识符

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
